description: BOOT-04 controlled bootstrap delivery recipient registry (operator-owned, never a secret). The Control composition loads this file; browsers, plugins and delivery requests can never supply a path, URL, owner UID or environment value. An entry with a non-empty resource_id is exact; an entry without resource_id is kind-level: it accepts every resource of resource_kind in the fixed directory and derives the installed file name from the exact delivery resource id (<resource_id>.bootstrap).
